description: Spring MVC Controller class for managing product options in the admin panel, including listing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting product options.

classes.name: OptionsController
classes.description: Controller for managing product options in the admin interface, including listing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting options.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the list of options.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the edit form for a specific option.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Prepares and displays the option creation or editing page.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a product option.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Handles POST request for paginated listing of options in JSON format.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for the admin interface.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a product option.
